title: Concept: Python requirement resolved from a local path
description: requirements.txt declares a requirement that installs from a path on the build machine, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The install is not reproducible from the requirements file, and the bytes that run are whatever that path holds at build time.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through requirements.txt (pypi).
risk: The install is not reproducible from the requirements file, and the bytes that run are whatever that path holds at build time.
